synopsis.native: Kada slučajno sazna da je preminula majka njegove bivše djevojke Mine, Simon odluči ukrasti tijelo pokojnice kako bi u Mini izazvao reakciju. Ona godinama nije bila u kontaktu sa svojom majkom zbog mračnih obiteljskih tajni. Simon planira nekoliko dana skrivati tijelo, a onda je oživjeti. No Simonu ukradu tijelo i on će ga pokušati vratiti. Ne znajući ništa o Simonovim nevoljama, Mina se suočava sa svojom prošlošću i emocionalnom prtljagom koju godinama nosi.
synopsis.english: After finding out by chance that his ex-girlfriend Mina's mother died, Simon decides to steal her body to provoke cathartic processes in Mina. Mina hasn't been in contact with her mother for years because of dark family secrets. Simon plans to keep the body hidden for a few days and then revive it; he possesses the powers needed to do this. However, the body is stolen from Simon and he has great difficulty retrieving it. Unaware of Simon's problems, Mina confronts her past and the emotional baggage she's been carrying for years.
